description: 防災マップデータ 防災マップ [fire, police and emergency services and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 大津市. 地域防災計画や平成16年度に実施した防災アセスメントの調査結果に基づき、地域毎の防災情報を地図上に示したものです。 ファイル内で使用しているフィールド名については「レイヤフィールド定義」にてご確認ください。 データ座標系 shapeデータ：世界測地系平面直角座標6系 KMLデータ：世界測地系経緯度. Coverage: 大津市. The portal files it under the publisher 大津市. Its tags are 災害, 防災. It offers 4 resource(s) in kml, shape, xlsx. The portal shows 2025-03-14 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
